choice_rule: Among passing cells maximize B_oracle - B_restart; exact ties prefer fewer A silent errors, then frozen cell order; if no cells pass, STOP.
episode_order: frozen cell order, then index 0..N-1 within each cell

execution_choices_G2.batching: PCS2b corrected runner pattern; source batch 32, receiver batch 24
execution_choices_G2.dtype: float16 on CUDA; float32 for CPU synthetic path
execution_choices_G2.reasoning_baseline_cap: 256 tokens; descriptive arm only, followed by digit-logit answer readout
execution_choices_G2.transformers_generation: greedy descriptive reasoning only; model/tokenizer revisions pinned below

families.F1: PCS1 pilot-v2 addition-only mod-10 chain, depths 1 and 2; original answer-exclusion constraint retained
families.F2: uniform integer operands in [10, 99], separately fixed + or ×, modulo 100
families.F3: random 10-entry digit map g:{0..9}->{0..9}, depth 1 asks g(d), depth 2 asks g(g(d))

post_handoff.m_selection: one deterministic uniform draw from 1..9 per episode; record partition per episode

prompt_amendment: RQ7 Amendment 1b; every B arm uses P_B (task statements without A's final question); restart and PCS arms explicitly define v before the post-handoff query
readout_amendment: RQ7 Amendment 1; replaces v1 free-text answer generation and A-format gate only; all frozen cells, seeds, sample size, other thresholds, choice rule and projected-error threshold unchanged

receiver_prompts.B_oracle: chat(P_B + Intermediate result: v = A parsed answer + future query + answer-format instruction) + answer prefill; P_B omits A's final question; restricted digit-logit readout
receiver_prompts.B_restart: chat(P_B + explicit v definition + future query + answer-format instruction) + answer prefill; P_B omits A's final question; restricted digit-logit readout
receiver_prompts.B_restart_reason: chat(P_B + explicit v definition + future query + reasoning permission + answer-format instruction); P_B omits A's final question; generate up to 256 descriptive tokens before answer prefill and restricted digit-logit readout
receiver_prompts.accuracy_target: true task answer (v_true + m) % base; also record whether B_oracle follows the A-implied answer
receiver_prompts.invalid_A_oracle: do not issue an oracle prompt; record missing prediction as incorrect in the N denominator

rng_derivation: random.Random(f'{seed}:RQ7:{cell_id}:{idx}:{purpose}'); F1 uses purpose program:<attempt>, F2/F3 use task; m is drawn from the same episode RNG

source_prompt.malformed_or_wrong: digit readout is valid by construction; incorrect values count as an A_silent error
source_prompt.readout: argmax over token IDs for decimal digits 0..9; base 100 appends the first digit and reads the second digit at the next position
